en: A historical black‑and‑white postcard showing a large column of British troops marching through a coastal town with Venetian-style fortifications and an old harbor. Many soldiers and officers are visible, along with civilians watching from rooftops and balconies. In the background are stone walls, bastions, and mixed Ottoman and Venetian architecture, including a minaret. On the right side of the postcard there is printed bilingual text in French and Greek describing the departure of British troops from Candia/Heraklion in July 1909.
